devices.label: Mill devices
devices.help:
Add one entry for each Mill device. Enter its IP address or hostname. The adapter automatically detects the MAC address and uses it as the device ID.
If "Poll when device is switched off" is unchecked, polling stops as soon as the adapter detects that the device is switched off. A subsequent switch-on performed outside ioBroker will not be detected. Polling resumes only after an adapter restart or when the device is switched on through ioBroker.

items.title: IP address or hostname
items.validatorErrorText: A valid IP address or hostname (without spaces or http://) is required.

items.title: Poll when device is switched off

apiTimeout.label: HTTP timeout
apiTimeout.help: Maximum wait time for a response from the local Mill API.
apiTimeout.validatorErrorText: HTTP timeout must be an integer between 1 and 60 seconds.

pollInterval1.label: Polling interval 1
pollInterval1.help: Interval for the normal (fast) polling in seconds. Must be at least HTTP timeout (${data.apiTimeout}) + 1 second.
pollInterval1.validatorErrorText: Polling interval 1 must be between ${data.apiTimeout + 1} and 3600 seconds.

pollInterval2.label: Polling interval 2
pollInterval2.help: Interval for the second, longer-term (slow) polling in seconds. Must be at least polling interval 1 (${data.pollInterval1}) + HTTP timeout (${data.apiTimeout}).
pollInterval2.validatorErrorText: Polling interval 2 must be between ${data.pollInterval1 + data.apiTimeout} and 86400 seconds.
